outline.chapter_title: Introduction to Large Context Windows and Positional Embeddings
outline.description: This chapter establishes the motivation for extending context windows in Large Language Models (LLMs), defines the limitations of current approaches, and introduces Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) as the foundational mechanism addressed in this research.
subtopics: The importance of large context windows for in-context learning and agent tasks
Current barriers: Catastrophic values, data scarcity, and computational costs
Overview of existing extension methods: Linear Interpolation (PI), NTK-aware scaling, and YaRN
Mathematical formulation of RoPE and rotary angles
Defining the context window extension ratio

outline.description: Before introducing the solution, this chapter details the empirical analysis conducted to understand why uniform interpolation fails. It explores the complex entropy distribution across RoPE dimensions and token positions.
subtopics: Investigating non-uniformity across RoPE dimensions (frequency bands)
Investigating non-uniformity across token positions (initial vs. later tokens)
Empirical Finding 1: Sub-optimality of current linear and grouped interpolation methods
Empirical Finding 2: The critical role of preserving initial token positions without interpolation
Impact of non-uniform interpolation on perplexity in zero-shot settings

outline.chapter_title: The LongRoPE Methodology: Search Space and Optimization
outline.description: This chapter provides a deep dive into the core algorithmic contribution of LongRoPE: framing positional interpolation as an optimization problem solved via evolutionary search.
subtopics: Problem formulation: Minimizing next-token prediction loss via rescale factors
Designing the search space: Dimension-specific rescale factors ($\lambda_i$) and position thresholds ($\hat{n}$)
The Evolutionary Search algorithm: Population initialization and selection
Optimization Technique 1: Seeding the population with PI, NTK, and YaRN baselines
Optimization Technique 2: Enforcing monotonically non-decreasing constraints based on NTK theory
Achieving 8x context extension without any fine-tuning

outline.chapter_title: Progressive Extension Strategy to 2 Million Tokens
outline.description: This chapter explains the multi-stage pipeline required to bridge the gap from standard context sizes to the unprecedented 2048k token limit efficiently.
subtopics: Challenges of direct fine-tuning at extreme scales (512x extension)
Stage 1: Searching and fine-tuning for intermediate lengths (128k and 256k)
Stage 2: Progressive fine-tuning workflow (stepping from 128k to 256k)
Stage 3: Secondary evolutionary search on the fine-tuned model to reach 2048k
Resource efficiency: Achieving results with only 1k fine-tuning steps
